Bug_Title: ASE: Method invoked in assertion may produce a side effect (ASE_ASSERTION_WITH_SIDE_EFFECT_METHOD)
Bug_Details:
Expressions used in assertions must not produce side effects. See SEI CERT Rule EXP06
for more information.
 SEI CERT Rule EXP06
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by invoking the method 'incrementCounter()' within an assertion statement. This method modifies the state of the 'counter' variable, thus producing a side effect.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test case triggers the bug by calling the'showBug' method, which contains an assertion that invokes the 'incrementCounter' method. This method modifies the state of the 'counter' variable, producing a side effect.
